Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP pressure, low-MP Focus, DRK macro, warnings, assists, and target clarity.
Description: A local PvP HUD integrating optional set-only low-MP Focus Target and exact DRK Shadowbringer macro helpers, a top-center 3+ enemy alarm with sound/Sprint options, isolation, pressure and CC-protection cues, resource auras, fail-closed assists, team communication and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds two separate default-off exact Crystalline Conflict helpers. Auto Low-MP Focus may set only an empty local native Focus Target to one trusted exact S1-S5 enemy at 2,000 MP or lower after the bounded low-MP latch and native 20-yalm range/line-of-sight proof; it never clears, replaces, restores, or retries, and manual focus changes win. The DRK /seitonbringer two-line ReAction Macro Queue/Turbo helper may attempt Shadowbringer at most once per proven 2.40-second Souleater Combo GCD, only in the inclusive 0.60-0.80-seconds-remaining window with exact target, Guard, resource, range, line-of-sight, queue, and readiness gates; it never changes a target, substitutes, replays, or retries. Schema 24 keeps both features off for fresh, upgraded, and reset settings; live current-patch Focus setter/readback and DRK queue/clip behavior remain confirmation boundaries.
